notes: New: Turn any mark you've added. Pick it with the Select tool and drag the round handle above it. Hold Shift to turn in 15° steps.
New: Turned text, shapes and blurs can still be moved, resized and edited.
New: Copy a picked mark with Ctrl+C and paste it with Ctrl+V, on the same snap or a different one.
New: Hold Space and drag to move around a zoomed-in picture.
Improved: Zooming now stays centered on your mouse pointer, or on the middle of the view when you use the buttons.
Improved: Ctrl + scroll wheel now zooms. The wheel on its own scrolls a zoomed-in picture up and down.
Improved: Button tips are clearer about what Rotate and Copy do, and about the new shortcuts.
